items.name: bui
items.title: Beautiful UI primitives
items.description: Beautiful UI's primitives (MIT) as pikit's dashboard has them, fed by real data: the sidebar, the composer, thinking, tool chips, task rows, pills, an operator's page, records tables, filter chips, a code block. They use the tokens and classes of the dashboard's src/index.css.

items.name: health-registry
items.title: health-registry
items.description: health-registry's view: What is up, degraded or down: components report their own state; /health fails when an essential one stays down, so the supervisor restarts the process. Its admin API routes come with the component (pikit add health-registry).
